cases.xfail_reason: FINDING: utils/directory_fields.py:660-671 (remove_unrequested_directory_fields) has a dedicated, unconditional path for any question matching r'\b(minimum|ordering|order)\b.*\b(order|size)\b|\border\s+size\b': it strips every payment-methods/delivery-cost/delivery-time/business-hours sentence from the answer, per the comment at line 660-663 ('an order-size answer still sheds unrelated payment/delivery/hours prose exactly as before').
